value_unit: SSTP system-tunnel engine with rich profile controls
decision_rationale: With feature breadth prioritized, SSTP now fills a real protocol gap. The donor profile plane is decomposed into a runtimecore engine, external-client capability discovery, process-tree lifecycle ownership, API fields, and advanced operator controls instead of importing donor app architecture.
invariant: SSTP can be started/stopped through the same runtime owner as other engines and preserves server, credentials, proxy, CA, certificate-warning and bounded PPP options
negative_invariant: SSTP does not create a parallel daemon/runtime authority and process shutdown remains owner-scoped
operator_surface: Operations / Runtime engines / SSTP advanced controls

value_unit: read-only local TCP port collision preflight
decision_rationale: The old desktop pre-connect collision probe is promoted because it materially improves startability and operator feedback with almost no architectural cost. LumiNet exposes it as a reusable local preflight API and widget.
invariant: operators can test a local bind target before starting a listener
negative_invariant: preflight is advisory/read-only and must not reserve or mutate the port

value_unit: signed update manifest discovery by URL
decision_rationale: Release discovery becomes more useful when fused with the existing fourth-order signed admission plane. A single HTTPS manifest URL now yields a bounded envelope and verified plan, replacing manual copy/paste while retaining target-native trust/version semantics.
invariant: one manifest URL produces a bounded signed envelope and an admission plan bound to the daemon build
negative_invariant: discovery cannot install or execute an artifact and redirect chains remain bounded

value_unit: verified update artifact staging and update-center workflow
decision_rationale: Previously separate donor update-dialog/download ideas are recomposed above signed admission: the operator can discover, inspect, verify and stage the exact artifact. This adds practical update workflow value without requiring donor-specific updater code.
invariant: staged bytes must match the admitted size and SHA-256 and are reusable by exact identity
negative_invariant: staging never executes, installs, or marks apply authorization true

value_unit: unified Operations workspace for readiness, diagnostics, engines and exports
decision_rationale: The donor diagnostic presentation value is promoted at a higher level: LumiNet combines existing doctor, diagnostic phases/jobs, engine capability inventory and export into one partial-failure-tolerant operator workspace instead of copying a speed-test widget.
invariant: each operations capability loads independently and successful widgets remain usable when another capability is unavailable
negative_invariant: UI state does not become daemon authority and unavailable capabilities are not presented as successful

value_unit: rich subscription profile management with mirror health and provider metadata
decision_rationale: Feature richness now justifies exposing profile management that already exists in the daemon: primary/mirrors, last-good source, per-source health, quota/expiry/announcement metadata, refresh, auto-refresh and active state are visible and actionable in one workspace.
invariant: profile UI reflects the existing ProfileService state and exposes refresh/source-health/provider metadata without inventing a second state store
negative_invariant: profile UI mutations go only through existing profile APIs and source health remains daemon-owned
operator_surface: Profiles / source health / quota / refresh controls
migration_impact: new product surface over existing owner

value_unit: bounded QLOG/qlog-seq local trace parser and summary
decision_rationale: QLOG becomes directly useful when treated as an operator import format rather than a transport authority. The control UI parses bounded local trace files, normalizes categories/events and produces summaries without adding daemon storage.
invariant: local trace parsing accepts supported QLOG forms with explicit byte/event ceilings
negative_invariant: trace parsing cannot allocate unbounded event collections or upload data implicitly

value_unit: Chrome NetLog normalization into the same trace model
decision_rationale: NetLog is promoted because one normalized viewer gives operators another high-value diagnostic input with little extra UI complexity. Numeric constant tables are resolved when present and events flow into the same bounded trace model.
invariant: NetLog events normalize into the same category/name/time/detail model as QLOG
negative_invariant: NetLog normalization must remain bounded by the shared trace parser limits

value_unit: interactive QLOG/NetLog viewer with filters and category counts
decision_rationale: The donor qlog visualization idea is promoted as a compact native widget: local file import, format/event summary, category chips, category selection, text filtering and bounded event rows. It is integrated into Operations rather than shipped as a separate web app.
invariant: operators can inspect large-but-bounded traces by category and text without leaving the control UI
negative_invariant: viewer renders only a bounded subset and does not make local trace data authoritative

value_unit: installable PWA shell with offline static fallback
decision_rationale: Offline/installable shell behavior materially improves usability for a local control application. The service worker caches only same-origin static GET shell assets; API requests stay network-only so an offline shell can still explain daemon unavailability without fabricating live state.
invariant: static shell remains launchable/offline and old shell caches are retired
negative_invariant: API and websocket-like requests are never satisfied from the static shell cache

value_unit: confirmed provider/support external links from rich profile metadata
decision_rationale: The link-confirmation affordance becomes useful once provider support/home-page metadata is visible in Profiles. Links are actionable with an explicit confirmation instead of being inert metadata.
invariant: provider support/home links can be opened directly from the profile workspace after an explicit user action
negative_invariant: non-web schemes are not opened by this UI helper
